title: Rename get_user to fetch_user
body: Pure rename for consistency with fetch_* helpers elsewhere. Behavior is unchanged.
author: dev

files.patch:
@@ -1,11 +1,12 @@
-"""User lookup."""
+"""User lookup. `get_user` was renamed to `fetch_user`; call sites updated."""
 
 DB = {
     1: {"name": "Ada", "email": "ada@example.com"},
     2: {"name": "Bob", "email": "bob@example.com"},
 }
 
 
-def get_user(user_id: int) -> dict | None:
+def fetch_user(user_id: int) -> dict | None:
     """Return the user record, or None if missing."""
     return DB.get(user_id)

@@ -1,7 +1,7 @@
-from users import get_user
+from users import fetch_user
 
 
 def greet(user_id: int) -> str:
-    user = get_user(user_id)
+    user = fetch_user(user_id)
     if user is None:
         return "hello, stranger"
     return f"hello, {user['name']}"
